mechanism_narrative: Sustained week-on-week improvement in RETAIL_REC (−36.0 → −28.3 over four weeks) reflects a monotonic recovery trend that will continue linearly over the next four weeks, producing higher mean RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 7.7 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decelerates or reverses direction in week t+1 or t+2, or mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has crossed from negative to positive territory (−4.6 → +3.3), signaling restored confidence in essential-goods access. This confidence spillover will drive discretionary RETAIL_REC upward as consumers resume non-essential shopping within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses zero and remains positive
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM reverts to negative values in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not show measurable acceleration within two weeks of the GROCERY_PHARM positive crossing.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility (−32.9 → −21.0) and WORKPLACES mobility (−38.7 → −33.1) are both improving. When both commuting-related proxies improve simultaneously, they unlock retail foot traffic via increased urban circulation; the interaction of restored commuting and workplace presence drives RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 11.9 points over four weeks
fact:WORKPLACES improved 5.6 points over four weeks
failure_condition: Either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES stalls or reverses in week t+1, or the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has stabilized at +8.7 to +10.1 (minimal variance), indicating a plateau in stay-at-home behavior. When residential confinement plateaus, policy restrictions are likely easing; this regime shift will permit RETAIL_REC to recover within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL variance across last two weeks is less than 0.5 percentage points
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL ranged 8.7–9.3 over last three weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL begins rising again in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not improve within one week of the RESIDENTIAL plateau.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains deeply depressed (−35.6) with minimal recovery (−40.9 → −35.6 over four weeks). Persistent outdoor-activity suppression indicates ongoing restrictions or behavioral avoidance; this constraint will suppress RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks, keeping it below baseline.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below −30 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at −35.6 with only 5.3-point improvement over four weeks
failure_condition: PARKS improves by more than 10 percentage points in a single week, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT mobility (−21.0) remains substantially depressed relative to WORKPLACES (−33.1), it signals that commuters are avoiding public transit despite returning to work. This modal shift away from transit reduces retail foot traffic in transit-adjacent retail zones, suppressing overall RETAIL_REC growth over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves faster than TRANSIT over two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES−TRANSIT gap is 12.1 points at t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT catches up to WORKPLACES within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has entered positive territory (+3.3), indicating essential-goods demand is now above baseline. This signals sufficient consumer purchasing power and confidence to sustain discretionary retail; RETAIL_REC will converge toward GROCERY_PHARM levels within two weeks as consumers reallocate to non-essentials.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM is positive and RETAIL_REC is negative
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM reverts to negative in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not narrow its gap to GROCERY_PHARM by at least 5 percentage points within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility (−33.1) remains severely depressed relative to RESIDENTIAL stability (+8.7), indicating sustained work-from-home policy or employer caution. This persistent workplace suppression will constrain RETAIL_REC recovery because office-district retail and commute-time shopping remain offline; RETAIL_REC will remain below −25 over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES remains below −30 for three consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES at −33.1 with only 5.6-point recovery over four weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES improves by more than 8 percentage points in a single week, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean.
